evidence: Devils Punchbowl Walking Track is signposted from Devils Punchbowl Falls car park.
The track then climbs steeply up through native mountain beech/tāwhairauriki forest to a viewing platform near the base of the waterfall.
Return to the car park the same way you came.

doubts: Start ref F2 is the road end where Devils Punchbowl Walking Track meets a road (named on the map as Otira Railway Tunnel); the text names only the car park off SH73 at the northern end of Arthur's Pass Village. End ref T9 is the waterfall point; the text's end is a viewing platform near the base of the waterfall. Order of Wardens Creek before the Bealey River bridge is from the hazards note ('Wardens Creek can flood the track before Bealey River bridge'); the bridge refs are the rivers they cross.
